typesense:latest.greeting:
Before everything changed, Yellow, Blue, Green, Red, and Orange were just living their usual lives inside the digital world. They had already survived battles, glitches, strange programs, and enemies that should have been impossible to defeat. No matter what happened, they always found a way to come back together.
But this time, something feels different.
Without warning, strange errors begin spreading across the system. Windows open by themselves, programs stop responding, and entire parts of the digital world start breaking apart. Yellow tries to understand the code behind it. Blue searches for anything that might help. Green stays alert, Red is already ready to fight, and Orange can’t shake the feeling that someone—or something—is watching them.
Far beyond their normal world, powerful figures begin to awaken. A black stick figure surrounded by an intense blue aura appears within the chaos. A mysterious gray figure moves through corrupted code, observing everything from a distance. And somewhere else, a powerful red presence begins tearing through the system with overwhelming force.
At first, the five think it might just be another enemy they can defeat together.
They quickly realize they’re wrong.
The corruption keeps spreading. The sky of their digital world starts cracking apart, buildings collapse into fragments of code, and portals begin opening to places they have never seen before. Whatever is happening isn’t targeting only them—it threatens the entire computer.
Now Yellow, Blue, Green, Red, and Orange will have to fight harder than ever, discover who is behind the attack, and uncover why these mysterious stick figures have suddenly appeared.
Because this isn’t just the beginning of another battle.
It’s the beginning of something much bigger.
EPISODE 1 — THE DIGITAL AWAKENING
